entries.name: CreateToolhelp32Snapshot
entries.description: CreateToolhelp32Snapshot is used to enumerate processes, threads, and modules. This function is commonly used by malware to enumerate processes before process injection.

entries.name: EnumDeviceDrivers
entries.description: EnumDeviceDrivers is used to enumerate drivers in the machine. This function is commonly used with kernel malware or for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: EnumProcesses
entries.description: EnumProcesses is used to enumerate processes in the machine. Process enumeration is often a precursor to process injection.

entries.name: EnumProcessModules
entries.description: EnumProcessModules is used to enumerate the loaded modules (executables and DLLs) for a given process. Malware enumerates through modules when doing injection.

entries.name: EnumProcessModulesEx
entries.description: EnumProcessModulesEx is used to enumerate the loaded modules (executables and DLLs) for a given process. Malware enumerates through modules when doing injection.

entries.name: FindFirstFileA
entries.description: FindFirstFileA is used to search through a directory and enumerate the filesystem.

entries.name: FindNextFileA
entries.description: FindNextFileA is used to search through a directory and enumerate the filesystem.

entries.name: GetLogicalProcessorInformation
entries.description: GetLogicalProcessorInformation is used to retrieve information about logical processors and related hardware. The function is used by malware for anti-debugging purposes.

entries.name: GetLogicalProcessorInformationEx
entries.description: GetLogicalProcessorInformationEx is used to retrieve information about logical processors and related hardware. The function is used by malware for anti-debugging purposes.

entries.name: GetModuleBaseNameA
entries.description: GetModuleBaseNameA is used to retrieve the base name of a specified module.

entries.name: GetSystemDefaultLangId
entries.description: GetSystemDefaultLangId is used to retrieve the language identifier for the system. This function is used by malware that wish to infect specific locales or simply wish to gather statistics on areas of infection.

entries.name: GetVersionExA
entries.description: GetVersionExA is a classic method used to retrieve the Windows version.

entries.name: GetWindowsDirectoryA
entries.description: GetWindowsDirectoryA is used to retreive the path to the Windows directory. This function may be used by malware retrieve the Windows path for additional installations.

entries.name: IsWoW64Process
entries.description: IsWow64Process is used by a 32-bit process to determine if it is running on a 64-bit operating system.

entries.name: Module32First
entries.description: Module32First is used as part of CreateToolHelp32Snapshot for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: Module32Next
entries.description: Module32Next is used as part of CreateToolHelp32Snapshot for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: Process32First
entries.description: Process32First is used as part of CreateToolhelp32Snapshot for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: Process32Next
entries.description: Process32Next is used as part of CreateToolhelp32Snapshot for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: ReadProcessMemory
entries.description: ReadProcessMemory can be used to read the memory of a remote process.

entries.name: Thread32First
entries.description: Thread32First is used as part of CreateToolhelp32Snapshot for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: Thread32Next
entries.description: Thread32Next is used as part of CreateToolhelp32Snapshot for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: GetSystemDirectoryA
entries.description: GetSystemDirectoryA retrieve the path of the system directory.

entries.name: GetSystemTime
entries.description: GetSystemTime is used to retrieve the current system date and time in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) format. This function is commonly used by malware for anti-debugging.

entries.name: GetComputerNameA
entries.description: GetComputerNameA is used to retrieve the computer name. This is commonly used by malware for anti-debugging purposes.

entries.name: VirtualQueryEx
entries.description: VirtualQueryEx is used to retrieve information about a range of pages within the virtual address space of a specified process. This function is commonly used by malware to enumerate an external process.

entries.name: GetProcessIdOfThread
entries.description: GetProcessIdOfThread is used to retrieve the process identifier of the process associated with the specified thread.

entries.name: GetProcessId
entries.description: GetProcessId is used to retrieve the process identifier of the specified process.

entries.name: GetCurrentThread
entries.description: GetCurrentThread is used to retrieve a handle for the calling thread.

entries.name: GetCurrentThreadId
entries.description: GetCurrentThreadId is used to retrieve the thread identifier of the calling thread.

entries.name: GetThreadId
entries.description: GetThreadId is used to retrieve the thread identifier of the specified thread.

entries.name: GetThreadInformation
entries.description: GetThreadInformation is used to retrieve information about the specified thread.

entries.name: GetCurrentProcess
entries.description: GetCurrentProcess is used to retrieve a handle for the current process.

entries.name: GetCurrentProcessId
entries.description: GetCurrentProcessId is used to retrieve the process identifier of the calling process.

entries.name: SearchPathA
entries.description: SearchPathA is used to search for a specified file in a specified path.

entries.name: GetFileTime
entries.description: GetFileTime is used to retrieve the date and time that a file or directory was created, last accessed, and last modified.

entries.name: GetFileAttributesA
entries.description: GetFileAttributesA is used to retrieve file system attributes for a specified file or directory.

entries.name: LookupPrivilegeValueA
entries.description: LookupPrivilegeValueA is used to retrieve the locally unique identifier (LUID) used on a specified system to locally represent the specified privilege name. This function is commonly used by malware in process injection or token stealing.

entries.name: LookupAccountNameA
entries.description: LookupAccountNameA is used to accept the name of a system and an account as input. It retrieves a security identifier (SID) for the account and the name of the domain on which the account was found.

entries.name: GetCurrentHwProfileA
entries.description: GetCurrentHwProfileA is used to retrieve information about the current hardware profile for the local computer. This function is commonly used by malware to anti-debugging purposes.

entries.name: GetUserNameA
entries.description: GetUserNameA is used to retrieve the username associated with the current thread. This function is used by malware for anti-debugging purposes.

entries.name: RegEnumKeyExA
entries.description: RegEnumKeyExA is used to enumerate the subkeys of the specified open registry key.

entries.name: RegQueryMultipleValuesA
entries.description: RegQueryMultipleValuesA is used to retrieve the type and data for a list of value names associated with an open registry key.

entries.name: NtQueryDirectoryFile
entries.description: NtQueryDirectoryFile is used to retrieve information about a directory. This function can be used for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: NtQueryInformationProcess
entries.description: NtQueryInformationProcess is used to retrieve information about a specified process.

entries.name: EnumWindows
entries.description: EnumWindows is used to enumerate all top-level windows on the screen by passing the handle to each window, in turn, to an application-defined callback function. This function is commonly used for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: NetShareCheck
entries.description: NetShareCheck is used to check whether or not a server is sharing a device.

entries.name: PathFileExistsA
entries.description: PathFileExistsA is used to determine whether a path to a file system object such as a file or folder is valid. This function is used by malware to enumerate files and installed programs (e.g. AV solutions).

entries.name: GetNativeSystemInfo
entries.description: GetNativeSystemInfo is used to retrieve information about the current system to an application running under WOW64. If the function is called from a 64-bit application, or on a 64-bit system that does not have an Intel64 or x64 processor (such as ARM64), it is equivalent to the GetSystemInfo function.

entries.name: GetLogicalDrives
entries.description: GetLogicalDrives is used to retrieve a bitmask representing the currently available disk drives. This function can be used to emumerate all drives / mounted drives.

entries.name: WNetEnumResourceA
entries.description: The WNetEnumResourceA function continues an enumeration of network resources that was started by a call to the WNetOpenEnum function.

entries.name: FindNextUrlCacheEntryA
entries.description: FindNextUrlCacheEntryA is used to retrieve the next entry in the Internet cache.

entries.name: WNetAddConnection2A
entries.description: The WNetAddConnection2A function makes a connection to a network resource and can redirect a local device to the network resource. The WNetAddConnection2 function supersedes the WNetAddConnection function.

entries.name: EnumResourceTypesA
entries.description: EnumResourceTypesA is used to enumerate resource types within a binary module. Starting with Windows Vista, this is typically a language-neutral Portable Executable (LN file), and the enumeration also includes resources from one of the corresponding language-specific resource files (.mui files)â€”if one existsâ€”that contain localizable language resources. It is also possible to use hModule to specify a .mui file, in which case only that file is searched for resource types. Alternately, applications can call EnumResourceTypesEx, which provides more precise control over which resource files to

entries.name: GetThreadLocale
entries.description: GetThreadLocale is used to retrieve the locale identifier of the current thread. Can be used alongside other language and/or locale APIs to geofence infections

entries.name: EnumSystemLocalesA
entries.description: EnumSystemLocalesA is used enumerate installed locale identifiers, all of the supported identifiers or alternate sort identifiers, according to which flag is passed to the API. Can be used to geofence infection campaigns or avoid infecting systems from a certain region/country. It can also be used to jump to allocated shellcode and execute it.

entries.name: CreateProcessA
entries.description: CreateProcessA is used to create a process. This function is used by malware in several process injection attacks such as process hollowing.

entries.name: GetModuleHandleA
entries.description: GetModuleHandleW is used to retrieve a module handle for the specified module. The module must have been loaded by the calling process. This function is often used along with GetProcAddress to dynamically retrieve the address of a function for evasion purposes.

entries.name: HeapCreate
entries.description: HeapCreate is used to allocate heap memory that can be used by the calling process.

entries.name: LoadLibraryExA
entries.description: LoadLibraryExA is used to load a specified module into the address space of the calling process. Malware commonly use this to load DLLs dynamically for evasion purposes.

entries.name: LocalAlloc
entries.description: LocalAlloc is used for heap allocation and manipulation.

entries.name: MapViewOfFile3
entries.description: MapViewOfFile3 is used for heap allocation and manipulation.

entries.name: MapViewOfFileEx
entries.description: MapViewOfFileEx is used for heap allocation and manipulation.

entries.name: QueueUserAPC
entries.description: QueueUserAPC is used to execute code for a different thread. This function is commonly used as part of process injection.

entries.name: Toolhelp32ReadProcessMemory
entries.description: Toolhelp32ReadProcessMemory can be used to read the memory of other processes.

entries.name: VirtualAlloc
entries.description: VirtualAlloc is often used by malware to allocate memory as part of process injection.

entries.name: VirtualProtectEx
entries.description: VirtualProtectEx is often used by malware to modify memory protection in a remote process (often to allow write or execution).

entries.name: WriteProcessMemory
entries.description: Writing data into a specified region of memory. This function is often used by malware as part of process injection to inject malicious code into a specified process.

entries.name: VirtualAlloc2
entries.description: VirtualAlloc2 is used to reserve or changes the state of a region of pages in the virtual address space of a specified process.

entries.name: VirtualProtectFromApp
entries.description: VirtualProtectFromApp is used to change the protection on a region of committed pages in the virtual address space of the calling process.

entries.name: OpenProcess
entries.description: OpenProcess is used to get a handle on a process. This function is commonly used by malware during process injection.

entries.name: OpenFileMappingA
entries.description: OpenFileMappingA is used to open a named file mapping object.

entries.name: GetProcessHeaps
entries.description: GetProcessHeaps is used to return the number of active heaps and retrieves handles to all of the active heaps for the calling process.

entries.name: GlobalAlloc
entries.description: GlobalAlloc is used to allocate the specified number of bytes from the heap.

entries.name: OpenProcessToken
entries.description: OpenProcessToken is used to open the access token associated with a process.

entries.name: CreateProcessWithTokenW
entries.description: CreateProcessWithTokenW is used to create a new process and its primary thread.

entries.name: NtAllocateVirtualMemory
entries.description: NtAllocateVirtualMemoy is used to reserve, commit, or both, a region of pages within the user-mode virtual address space of a specified process.

entries.name: NtCreateProcessEx
entries.description: NtCreateProcessEx is used to create a new process.

entries.name: NtCreateThreadEx
entries.description: NtCreateThreadEx is used to create a new thread.

entries.name: NtCreateUserProcess
entries.description: NtCreateUserProcess is used to create a new process.

entries.name: NtMapViewOfSection
entries.description: NtMapViewOfSection is used to map a view of a section into the virtual address space of a subject process. This function is used by malware as part of process injection.

entries.name: NtProtectVirtualMemory
entries.description: NtProtectVirtualMemory is used to interact with and modify memory regions.

entries.name: NtQueueApcThreadEx2
entries.description: NtQueueApcThreadEx2 is a new system call that allows to pass both UserApcFlags and MemoryReserveHandle.

entries.name: NtReadVirtualMemory
entries.description: NtReadVirtualMemory is used to copy data in the specified address range from the address space of the specified process into the specified buffer of the current process

entries.name: NtUnmapViewOfSection
entries.description: NtUnmapViewOfSection is used to unmap a view of a section from the virtual address space of a subject process.

entries.name: NtWriteVirtualMemory
entries.description: NtWriteVirtualMemory is used to copy the specified address range from the current process into the specified address range of the specified process.

entries.name: RtlMoveMemory
entries.description: RtlMoveMemory is used to copy the contents of a source memory block to a destination memory block, and supports overlapping source and destination memory blocks.

entries.name: RtlCopyMemory
entries.description: RtlCopyMemory is used to copy the contents of a source memory block to a destination memory block.

entries.name: WaitForSingleObjectEx
entries.description: WaitForSingleObjectEx is used to delay the execution of an object. This function is commonly used to allow time for shellcode being executed within a thread to run. It is also used for time-based evasion.

entries.name: KeInsertQueueApc
entries.description: KeInsertQueueApc is responsible for attaching an initialized APC to the APC queue of its target thread

entries.name: NtResumeProcess
entries.description: NtResumeProcess is used to resume a suspended process

entries.name: CreateProcessInternal
entries.description: CreateProcessInternal is an undocumented API for process creation. According to Windows Internals, CreateProcess and CreateProcessAsUser actually lead to this API, which is responsible for starting the process creation in user land. Eventually it calls NtCreateUserProcess for the kernel land operations. This API is commonly used for spawning a suspended process to be hollowed/injected.

entries.name: UuidFromStringA
entries.description: UuidFromStringA is used to convert a string to a UUID. This function can be abused to both decode data and write it to memory without using common functions such as memcpy or WriteProcessMemory.

entries.name: DeleteFileA
entries.description: DeleteFileA is used to delete an existing file. This function is used by malware to hide its tracks or tamper with an application.

entries.name: SetFileTime
entries.description: SetFileTime sets the date and time that the specified file or directory was created, last accessed, or last modified. This function is often used by malware to conceal malicious activity.

entries.name: SleepEx
entries.description: SleepEx is used to suspend the execution of the current thread for a set time. This function is commonly used for time-based evasion by adding delays in the code.

entries.name: CreateWindowExA
entries.description: CreateWindowExA is used to create an overlapped, pop-up, or child window with an extended window style. This function is commonly used by malware to create invisible windows or for evasion purposes.

entries.name: RegisterHotKey
entries.description: RegisterHotKey is used to create a system wide hotkey. This function is commonly used by spyware or keyloggers to recieve a notification when a certain combination of keys are pressed.

entries.name: SetWaitableTimer
entries.description: SetWaitableTimer is used to activate the specified waitable timer. This function is commonly used by malware for time-based evasion.

entries.name: SetTimer
entries.description: SetTimer is used to create a timer with the specified time-out value. This function is commonly used by malware for time-based evasion

entries.name: Select
entries.description: Select is used to determine the status of one or more sockets, waiting if necessary, to perform synchronous I/O. This function is used by malware for time-based evasion by setting a large timeout number.

entries.name: SetThreadToken
entries.description: The SetThreadToken function assigns an impersonation token to a thread. The function can also cause a thread to stop using an impersonation token.

entries.name: TimeGetTime
entries.description: TimeGetTime is used to retrieve the system time, in milliseconds. The system time is the time elapsed since Windows was started.

entries.name: CallNextHookEx
entries.description: CallNextHookEx is used within code that is hooking an event set by SetWindowsHookEx. CallNextHookEx calls the next hook in the chain. This function is commonly used by keyloggers.

entries.name: GetDC
entries.description: GetDC is used to retrieve a handle to a device context (DC) for the client area of a specified window or for the entire screen. This function is commonly used by spyware for taking screenshots.

entries.name: GetDCEx
entries.description: GetDCEx is used to retrieve a handle to a device context (DC) for the client area of a specified window or for the entire screen. This function is commonly used by spyware for taking screenshots.

entries.name: GetKeyboardState
entries.description: GetKeyboardState is used to copy the status of the 256 virtual keys to the specified buffer. This function is commonly used by keyloggers.

entries.name: GetRawInputData
entries.description: GetRawInputData is used to retrieve the raw input data from a specified device. This function is commonly used by keyloggers.

entries.name: MapVirtualKeyExA
entries.description: MapVirtualKeyExA is used to map a virtual-key code into a scan code or character value, or translates a scan code into a virtual-key code. This function is commonly used by spyware and keyloggers.

entries.name: PeekMessageA
entries.description: PeekMessageA is used to check for incoming sent messages, checks the thread message queue for a posted message, and retrieves the message (if any exist).

entries.name: PostThreadMessageA
entries.description: PostThreadMessageA is used to post a message to the message queue of the specified thread.

entries.name: SendMessageCallbackA
entries.description: SendMessageCallbackA is used to send the specified message to a window or windows.

entries.name: SetWindowsHookExA
entries.description: SetWindowsHookExA is used to install an application-defined hook procedure into a hook chain. This function is commonly used by keyloggers.

entries.name: UnhookWindowsHookEx
entries.description: UnhookWindowsHookEx is used to remove a hook procedure installed in a hook chain by the SetWindowsHookEx function.

entries.name: BitBlt
entries.description: BitBlt is used to copy graphic data from one device to another. Spyware sometimes uses this function to capture screenshots.

entries.name: WinExec
entries.description: WinExec is used to allow the execution of an application.

entries.name: HttpSendRequestA
entries.description: HttpSendRequestA is used to send a HTTP request to a server.

entries.name: InternetOpenA
entries.description: InternetOpenA is used to initialize the use of WinINet functions.

entries.name: InternetOpenUrlA
entries.description: InternetOpenUrlA is used to open a resource specified by a complete FTP or HTTP URL.

entries.name: InternetReadFileExA
entries.description: InternetReadFileExA is used to read data from a handle opened by the InternetOpenUrl or HttpOpenRequest function.

entries.name: URLDownloadToCacheFile
entries.description: URLDownloadToCacheFile is used to download data to the Internet cache and returns the file name of the cache location for retrieving the bits.

entries.name: Accept
entries.description: Accept is used to permit an incoming connection attempt on a socket.

entries.name: Connect
entries.description: Connect is used to establish a connection to a specified socket.

entries.name: Gethostbyname
entries.description: gethostbyname is used to retrieve host information corresponding to a host name from a host database.

entries.name: Send
entries.description: Send is used to send data on a connected socket.

entries.name: Socket
entries.description: socket is used create a socket that is bound to a specific transport service provider.

entries.name: WSACleanup
entries.description: WSACleanup is used to terminate the use of the Winsock 2 DLL. This function is commonly used by malware upon successfully utilizing the Winsock 2 functions.

entries.name: ShellExecuteA
entries.description: ShellExecuteA is used to perform an operation on a specified file.

entries.name: DnsQueryEx
entries.description: DnsQueryEx is used to send a DNS query. This may be used for communications over a DNS tunnel.

entries.name: InternetSetOptionA
entries.description: InternetSetOptionA is used to set an Internet option.

entries.name: Closesocket
entries.description: Closesocket is used to close an existing socket.

entries.name: WSAIoctl
entries.description: WSAIoctl Can be used to retrieve and set socket mode. E.g.: Put NIC in 'Promiscuous Mode'

entries.name: GetTickCount
entries.description: GetTickCount is used to retrieve the number of milliseconds since bootup. This function is used by malware for anti-debugging purposes.

entries.name: IsDebuggerPresent
entries.description: IsDebuggerPresent is used to determine whether the calling process is being debugged by a user-mode debugger.

entries.name: FindWindowExA
entries.description: FindWindowExA is used to get a handle to the top-level window whose class name and window name match the specified strings. This function is commonly used by malware as an anti-debugging technique.

entries.name: GetTickCount64
entries.description: GetTickCount64 is used to retrieve the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the system was started. This function is used by malware for anti-debugging purposes by checking how long the system uptime is.

entries.name: CryptAcquireContextA
entries.description: CryptAcquireContextA is used to acquire a handle to a particular key container within a particular cryptographic service provider (CSP)

entries.name: EncryptFileA
entries.description: EncryptFileA is used to encrypt a file or directory.

entries.name: CryptCreateHash
entries.description: CryptCreateHash is used to create a hash.

entries.name: CryptDeriveKey
entries.description: CryptDeriveKey is used to create encryption keys.

entries.name: CryptSetKeyParam
entries.description: CryptSetKeyParam is used to customize various aspects of a session key's operations.

entries.name: CryptGenRandom
entries.description: CryptGenRandom is used to fill a buffer with cryptographically random bytes.

entries.name: CryptStringToBinary
entries.description: The CryptStringToBinary function is used to convert a formatted string into an array of bytes.

entries.name: CryptReleaseContext
entries.description: The CryptReleaseContext function is used to release the handle of a cryptographic service provider (CSP) and a key container.

entries.name: CryptDestroyHash
entries.description: The CryptDestroyHash function destroys the hash object referenced by the hHash parameter. After a hash object has been destroyed, it can no longer be used.

entries.name: CreateFileA
entries.description: CreateFileA is used to create a new file or opens an existing file.

entries.name: DeviceIoControl
entries.description: DeviceIoControl is used to send a control message from user space to a device driver. DeviceIoControl is popular with kernel malware because it is an easy, flexible way to pass information between user space and kernel space.

entries.name: GetModuleFileNameA
entries.description: GetModuleFileNameA is used to return the filename of a module that is loaded in the current process. Malware can use this function to modify or copy files in the currently running process.

entries.name: GetTempPathA
entries.description: GetTempPathA is used to retrieve the path of the directory designated for temporary files. This is often used by malware when it requires a location for additional installations.

entries.name: MoveFileA
entries.description: MoveFileA is used to move an existing file or a directory, including its children.

entries.name: MoveFileExA
entries.description: MoveFileExA is used to move an existing file or a directory, including its children.

entries.name: WriteFile
entries.description: WriteFile is used to write data to the specified file or input/output (I/O) device.

entries.name: CopyFileExA
entries.description: CopyFileExA is used to copy an existing file to a new file.

entries.name: TerminateProcess
entries.description: TerminateProcess is used to terminate a process.

entries.name: SetCurrentDirectory
entries.description: SetCurrentDirectory is used to change the current directory for the current process.

entries.name: SetThreadPriority
entries.description: SetThreadPriority is used to set the priority value for the specified thread. This value, together with the priority class of the thread's process, determines the thread's base priority level.

entries.name: ControlServiceExA
entries.description: ControlServiceExA is used to start, stop, modify, or send a signal to a running service. This function is commonly used by malware went it requires interaction with a service for malicious purposes.

entries.name: OpenSCManagerA
entries.description: OpenSCManagerA is used to open a handle to the service control manager. This function is commonly used when a malware intends to interact with a service.

entries.name: OpenServiceA
entries.description: OpenServiceA is used to open an existing service.

entries.name: RegOpenKeyExA
entries.description: RegOpenKeyExA is used to open a specified registry key.

entries.name: RegCreateKeyExA
entries.description: RegCreateKeyExA is used to create a specified registry key. If the key already exists, the function opens it.

entries.name: RegSetKeyValueA
entries.description: RegSetKeyValueA is used to set a value for a given registry key.

entries.name: RegFlushKey
entries.description: RegFlushKey is used to write all the attributes of the specified open registry key into the registry.

entries.name: RegGetKeySecurity
entries.description: RegGetKeySecurity is used to retrieve a copy of the security descriptor protecting the specified open registry key.

entries.name: RegLoadMUIStringA
entries.description: RegLoadMUIStringA is used to load the specified string from the specified key and subkey.

entries.name: RegOpenUserClassesRoot
entries.description: RegOpenUserClassesRoot is used to retrieve a handle to the HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT key for a specified user.

entries.name: RegRestoreKeyA
entries.description: RegRestoreKeyA is used to read the registry information in a specified file and copies it over the specified key.

entries.name: RegSaveKeyA
entries.description: RegSaveKeyA is used to save the specified key and all of its subkeys and values to a registry file, in the specified format.

entries.name: RegSetKeySecurity
entries.description: RegSetKeySecurity is used to set the security of an open registry key.

entries.name: RegCopyTreeA
entries.description: RegCopyTreeA is used to copy the specified registry key, along with its values and subkeys, to the specified destination key.

entries.name: RegDeleteKeyExA
entries.description: RegDeleteKeyExA is used to delete a subkey and its values from the specified platform-specific view of the registry.

entries.name: RegDeleteTreeA
entries.description: RegDeleteTreeA is used to delete the subkeys and values of the specified key recursively.

entries.name: RegCloseKey
entries.description: RegCloseKey is used to close a handle to the specified registry key.

entries.name: NtCreateFile
entries.description: NtCreateFile is used to create a new file or directory, or opens an existing file, device, directory, or volume.

entries.name: NtSetInformationProcess
entries.description: NtSetInformationProcess is used to modify information about a process such making it a critical process.

entries.name: NtSetInformationThread
entries.description: NtSetInformationThread is used to set the priority of a thread.

entries.name: NtSetSystemEnvironmentValueEx
entries.description: NtSetSystemEnvironmentValueEx is used to set a system environment variable.

entries.name: NtShutdownSystem
entries.description: NtShutdownSystem is used to shutdown the system.

entries.name: RtlSetProcessIsCritical
entries.description: RtlSetProcessIsCritical is used to set a process to a system critical status. This function is used by malware to prevent the process from being terminated.

entries.name: SetClipboardData
entries.description: SetClipboardData is used to place data on the clipboard in a specified clipboard format.

entries.name: OpenClipboard
entries.description: OpenClipboard is used to get a handle on the clipboard.

entries.name: SetForegroundWindow
entries.description: SetForegroundWindow is used for bring the thread that created the specified window into the foreground and activates the window

entries.name: SetFocus
entries.description: SetFocus is used to set the keyboard focus to the specified window

entries.name: NetShareAdd
entries.description: NetShareAdd is used to share a server resource.

entries.name: CallWindowProcA
entries.description: CallWindowProcA is used to pass message information to the specified window procedure.

entries.name: lstrcatA
entries.description: lstrcatA is used to append one string to another.
